findings.evidence: `grep -r ExclKinematics code/EpsilonEridani` matches only `Exclusive/Kinematics/Basic.lean` and the new file, so no such conversion exists; `Polarized/Kinematics.lean:66` shows the repo's idiom of naming the inclusive view (`extends DisKinematics` with `toDisKinematics` and `@[simp]` lemmas at lines 86-90) rather than inlining a literal.
findings.fix: Add a public `ExclKinematics.toDis (K : ExclKinematics V) : DisKinematics V := { p := K.p, pPrime := K.pPrime, k := K.k, kPrime := K.kPrime, q := K.q, hq := K.hqLepton }` in `Exclusive/Kinematics/Basic.lean` with `@[simp]` projection lemmas, and restate `ofExcl_x` as `(ofExcl ...).x = DisKinematics.xBj g K.toDis`.
findings.issue: ofExcl_x states its right-hand side against an inline `DisKinematics` anonymous constructor. The exclusive-to-inclusive view is therefore public API with no name: a consumer must reproduce the exact record literal to apply the lemma, and cannot reach any other inclusive variable (`yInel`, `W2`) of the same event. That conversion mentions only `ExclKinematics`/`DisKinematics` and nothing diffractive, so it is general infrastructure whose canonical home is the exclusive kinematics file.

findings.evidence: Lines 105-111 are the whole `absT` API; `abs_of_nonpos` is available upstream (e.g. `upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Order/CauSeq/BigOperators.lean:170` uses it).
findings.issue: `absT` is named for `|t|` but no lemma connects it to `abs`: the API offers only `absT_eq_neg_t` and `absT_nonneg`, so a goal arriving with `|i.t|` (from any Mathlib `abs` lemma) cannot be rewritten into the canonical `absT` form that Convention 2 requires all momentum-transfer power laws to use.

findings.evidence: Lines 230-246 give only `tMinElastic_def`, `tMinElastic_xi_zero` and `tMinElastic_nonpos`; nothing mentions `absT`, and `grep absT` in the repo shows `absT` occurs only at lines 103-111.
findings.fix: Add the companion restatement, e.g. `theorem neg_tMinElastic (M xi : ℝ) : -tMinElastic M xi = xi ^ 2 * M ^ 2 / (1 - xi)` and/or `theorem le_tMinElastic_iff_le_absT (i : Invariants) (M xi : ℝ) : i.t ≤ tMinElastic M xi ↔ xi ^ 2 * M ^ 2 / (1 - xi) ≤ i.absT`.
findings.issue: The `tMinElastic` docstring asserts the boundary is "equivalently `|t| ≥ ξ²M²/(1-ξ)`", but no lemma states the magnitude form, so a consumer who writes the boundary in `absT` (as Convention 2 mandates) has to redo the sign manipulation at each use site.

summary: The surface is minimal and bodies stay hidden, but the exclusive-to-inclusive view is published only as an anonymous record literal inside ofExcl_x, and absT/tMinElastic lack the magnitude-side lemmas their names and docstrings promise.
